says: The rungs are a join of measured layers. The TRANSITIONS are mostly not measured, and each unmeasured one carries the reason rather than a plausible number. Two of six have a retention behind them; a ladder that printed a figure at every step would be the failure this repository exists to refuse.
limits: Variant positions come from ClinVar through gene_geometry.py and inherit its parsing losses; a gene's unplaced variants are simply absent from the residue rung.
STRING partners are co-functional associations, not physical complexes, and the 700 cut is conventional.
The organ systems are those of the gene's DISEASES, so a gene causing one well-annotated disease looks broader than a gene causing three thin ones.
